moto-gloves-polygon.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Polygon
moto-gloves-polygon.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. It has been constructed from a mix of man-made materials and leather in various shades of blue.

driver-gloves-garden.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Garden
driver-gloves-garden.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

driver-gloves-seigaiha.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Seigaiha
driver-gloves-seigaiha.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

sport-gloves-hedge-maze.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Hedge Maze
sport-gloves-hedge-maze.desc:
Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. The green and white gloves were manufactured by Icarus Athletics.

Only cowards fear flying close to the sun

broken-fang-gloves-yellow-banded.name: ★ Broken Fang Gloves | Yellow-banded
broken-fang-gloves-yellow-banded.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.

ak-47-elite-build.name: AK-47 | Elite Build
ak-47-elite-build.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted using a combination of hydrographics and careful stenciling and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

Tread softly Naomi...people in your line of work aren't known for their longevity - The Shield and The Serpent Part 2

ak-47-safari-mesh.name: AK-47 | Safari Mesh
ak-47-safari-mesh.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

aug-lapis-lazuli.name: AUG | Lapis Lazuli
aug-lapis-lazuli.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted with a white, blue, and gold design to resemble lapis lazuli.

An exquisite piece, both powerful and fragile

aug-luxe-trim.name: AUG | Luxe Trim
aug-luxe-trim.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted to replicate the look and feel of a puffer jacket and finished with bronze accents.

The premium package

awp-paw.name: AWP | PAW
awp-paw.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A pattern of felines, K-9s, and a creature with a red scarf has been applied.

Kill rewards paid in scratching posts and tennis balls

awp-hyper-beast.name: AWP | Hyper Beast
awp-hyper-beast.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a beastly creature in psychedelic colors.

You really want to impress me Booth? Make this black light sensitive - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

awp-pink-ddpat.name: AWP | Pink DDPAT
awp-pink-ddpat.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

pp-bizon-space-cat.name: PP-Bizon | Space Cat
pp-bizon-space-cat.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A space art depiction of a cat has been custom painted over a black and purple base.

The paws of creation

cz75-auto-vendetta.name: CZ75-Auto | Vendetta
cz75-auto-vendetta.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. Through the years it has been etched into, drawn on, and hardened with use.

From my cold, dead hands

desert-eagle-tilted.name: Desert Eagle | Tilted
desert-eagle-tilted.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Its aqua-colored base has been tagged with graffiti from different artists.

"I want EVERY round"

desert-eagle-crimson-web.name: Desert Eagle | Crimson Web
desert-eagle-crimson-web.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

famas-commemoration.name: FAMAS | Commemoration
famas-commemoration.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted gold and features various details celebrating 20 years of Counter-Strike.

Here's to 20 more

five-seven-heat-treated.name: Five-SeveN | Heat Treated
five-seven-heat-treated.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

five-seven-monkey-business.name: Five-SeveN | Monkey Business
five-seven-monkey-business.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It's a banana.

Sometimes it's ok to play with your food

galil-ar-eco.name: Galil AR | Eco
galil-ar-eco.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted white and green and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

For enough money, Elite Crew will take any cause on as their own

galil-ar-cold-fusion.name: Galil AR | Cold Fusion
galil-ar-cold-fusion.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A toxic, pale blue hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Hypotheses are never proven

galil-ar-tornado.name: Galil AR | Tornado
galil-ar-tornado.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Don't be fooled by its simplicity

glock-18-blue-fissure.name: Glock-18 | Blue Fissure
glock-18-blue-fissure.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a craquelure pattern.

glock-18-night.name: Glock-18 | Night
glock-18-night.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

survival-knife-stained.name: ★ Survival Knife | Stained
survival-knife-stained.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

paracord-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Tiger Tooth
paracord-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

gut-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Gut Knife | Gamma Doppler
gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

karambit-slaughter.name: ★ Karambit | Slaughter
karambit-slaughter.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

m9-bayonet-ultraviolet.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Ultraviolet
m9-bayonet-ultraviolet.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

skeleton-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Ultraviolet
skeleton-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

huntsman-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Case Hardened
huntsman-knife-case-hardened.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

ursus-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

ursus-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Night Stripe
ursus-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

m249-impact-drill.name: M249 | Impact Drill
m249-impact-drill.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a blue and orange color scheme.

The great equalizer

m4a4-desolate-space.name: M4A4 | Desolate Space
m4a4-desolate-space.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a space theme.

"We've lost contact"

m4a4-tooth-fairy.name: M4A4 | Tooth Fairy
m4a4-tooth-fairy.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A custom paint job depicting incisors, molars, and a chilling take on the Tooth Fairy has been applied.

No one said the teeth have to be yours…

m4a1-s-guardian.name: M4A1-S | Guardian
m4a1-s-guardian.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted cobalt blue and stenciled with the CT logo on the magazine.

I don't have to like you, I have to keep you safe - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

m4a1-s-flashback.name: M4A1-S | Flashback
m4a1-s-flashback.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been hand painted in an attempt to make a suggestion about the duality of man.

For the joker in all of us

m4a1-s-nightmare.name: M4A1-S | Nightmare
m4a1-s-nightmare.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A custom paint job depicting a frightening nocturnal visitor has been applied.

Next time set an alarm

m4a1-s-night-terror.name: M4A1-S | Night Terror
m4a1-s-night-terror.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. Scattered thoughts from the mind of an insomniac have been scrawled across this custom-painted A1-S.

In the bosom of the gentle night, is when I search for the light

m4a1-s-rose-hex.name: M4A1-S | Rose Hex
m4a1-s-rose-hex.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A hydrographic hex pattern has been applied.

Hex marks the spot

m4a1-s-black-lotus.name: M4A1-S | Black Lotus
m4a1-s-black-lotus.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a black lotus flower over a blue and purple base.

Adds 2 kills during rifle round, then is discarded

mac-10-sakkaku.name: MAC-10 | Sakkaku
mac-10-sakkaku.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. In specific lighting the eyes on this custom painted MAC-10 glow red.

Make your perception their reality

mag-7-cinquedea.name: MAG-7 | Cinquedea
mag-7-cinquedea.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted with patterned glass panels and a red grip and pump.

"Whatever you paid for this, it wasn't enough"

mag-7-firestarter.name: MAG-7 | Firestarter
mag-7-firestarter.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been spray-painted in layers then distressed to give the appearance of burning edges.

It always begins with a tiny spark

mp5-sd-kitbash.name: MP5-SD | Kitbash
mp5-sd-kitbash.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. 20 years of MP5 designs have contributed to this custom paint job, held together by duct tape, zip ties, and glue.

If at first (and second and third) you don't succeed…

mp7-neon-ply.name: MP7 | Neon Ply
mp7-neon-ply.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been laminated and filled with every neon color imaginable.

"Roy G. Biv? Never heard of 'em."

mp7-skulls.name: MP7 | Skulls
mp7-skulls.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using a skull-patterned hydrographic with red or black accents.

A mass grave that fits snugly in the palm of your hands

mp7-smoking-kills.name: MP7 | Smoking Kills
mp7-smoking-kills.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with a colorful design featuring a woman in glasses smoking a cigarette.

"We can do this fast or slow, it's your call"

mp9-deadly-poison.name: MP9 | Deadly Poison
mp9-deadly-poison.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted with dynamic, angular shapes and a stylized spider.

It's not the first bite that kills you, it's the 29 that come after

mp9-hydra.name: MP9 | Hydra
mp9-hydra.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A custom paint job referencing Operation Hydra, CS:GO's 8th Operation, has been applied.

Worth the wait

mp9-buff-blue.name: MP9 | Buff Blue
mp9-buff-blue.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been spray-painted with a worn, blue pattern.

That's gonna leave a mark!

mp9-sand-dashed.name: MP9 | Sand Dashed
mp9-sand-dashed.desc: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

nova-quick-sand.name: Nova | Quick Sand
nova-quick-sand.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A tan and blue hydrographic pattern has been applied to the stock and receiver. The barrel has been painted dark blue.

"A welcome sight" would be putting it lightly

p250-exchanger.name: P250 | Exchanger
p250-exchanger.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A hydrographic pattern of interweaving pipes has been applied.

"My life for yours"

p250-bullfrog.name: P250 | Bullfrog
p250-bullfrog.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with racing liveries in bronze and black.

Look at you go!

p250-bone-mask.name: P250 | Bone Mask
p250-bone-mask.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

p90-ancient-earth.name: P90 | Ancient Earth
p90-ancient-earth.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A brown and gold pattern featuring intricate linework and ancient creatures has been applied.

The privilege is yours

p90-randy-rush.name: P90 | Randy Rush
p90-randy-rush.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. This custom paint job features camouflage, military insignia, and... Randy. For better or worse.

"Or how I learned to stop worrying and love the P90"

r8-revolver-monarch.name: R8 Revolver | Monarch
r8-revolver-monarch.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been custom painted in orange and grey and features brass-finished controls.

A symbol of status and authority

sawed-off-the-kraken.name: Sawed-Off | The Kraken
sawed-off-the-kraken.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been hand painted with an image of an octopus.

It has been unleashed

sawed-off-full-stop.name: Sawed-Off | Full Stop
sawed-off-full-stop.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

scar-20-powercore.name: SCAR-20 | Powercore
scar-20-powercore.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been custom painted in green with yellow accents, then given a USB code for quick checkout.

Rule No. 1 – Challenge demands satisfaction

sg-553-danger-close.name: SG 553 | Danger Close
sg-553-danger-close.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been hand painted with a metallic-fire themed design.

Watch your fire

sg-553-tiger-moth.name: SG 553 | Tiger Moth
sg-553-tiger-moth.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted with a moth wing pattern.

Valeria is getting bolder... the time has come to take the fight to her - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

sg-553-fallout-warning.name: SG 553 | Fallout Warning
sg-553-fallout-warning.desc: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

ssg-08-slashed.name: SSG 08 | Slashed
ssg-08-slashed.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a claw mark pattern.

ssg-08-azure-glyph.name: SSG 08 | Azure Glyph
ssg-08-azure-glyph.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with blue water, Egyptian hieroglyphs, and finished with wood running the length of the weapon.

Flood warning

ssg-08-orange-filigree.name: SSG 08 | Orange Filigree
ssg-08-orange-filigree.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. An orange millefleur hydrographic has been applied.

Perhaps this is one piece of art better left in the past

ssg-08-prey.name: SSG 08 | Prey
ssg-08-prey.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been spray-painted with a rust colored zebra stripe pattern.

Eat, sleep, hunt, repeat

tec-9-remote-control.name: Tec-9 | Remote Control
tec-9-remote-control.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been hand painted with colorful dials and switches atop a blue base.

Don't touch that dial

tec-9-fubar.name: Tec-9 | Fubar
tec-9-fubar.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. The muzzle of this military themed weapon has been scorched with use.

You call it used, we call it well-loved

tec-9-tiger-stencil.name: Tec-9 | Tiger Stencil
tec-9-tiger-stencil.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A smoke and sand-colored tiger pattern has been applied.

The title "King of the Jungle" is up for debate

usp-s-serum.name: USP-S | Serum
usp-s-serum.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been painted in a digital pattern with metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

usp-s-stainless.name: USP-S | Stainless
usp-s-stainless.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has a stainless steel slide.

xm1014-gum-wall-camo.name: XM1014 | Gum Wall Camo
xm1014-gum-wall-camo.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a purple and pink drippy camo pattern.

Don't overthink it

m9-bayonet.name: ★ M9 Bayonet
m9-bayonet.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat.

skeleton-knife.name: ★ Skeleton Knife
skeleton-knife.desc: This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety.
